text: Once upon a time. <break time="0.8s" /> There was a king. <break time="0.8s" /> You may say. <break time="0.8s" /> But you are wrong. <break time="0.8s" /> Once upon a time. <break time="0.8s" /> There was only. <break time="0.8s" /> A simple piece of wood. <break time="0.8s" /> It was not expensive wood. <break time="0.8s" /> But a common log. <break time="0.8s" /> That people burned in winter. <break time="0.8s" /> One day this log came. <break time="0.8s" /> To the shop of an old carpenter. <break time="0.8s" /> Named Master Antonio. <break time="0.8s" /> Everyone called him Master Cherry. <break time="0.8s" /> Because his nose was red and shiny. <break time="0.8s" /> Like a ripe cherry. <break time="0.8s" /> When he saw the log. <break time="0.8s" /> He was very happy. <break time="0.8s" /> And rubbed his hands together. <break time="0.8s" /> I will make a leg for my little table with this. <break time="0.8s" /> He said. <break time="0.8s" /> He picked up his sharp axe. <break time="0.8s" /> But just then. <break time="0.8s" /> He heard a tiny voice. <break time="0.8s" /> Please do not hit me. <break time="0.8s" /> So hard. <break time="0.8s" /> Cried the voice. <break time="0.8s" /> Master Cherry looked all around the room. <break time="0.8s" /> But he found nobody there. <break time="0.8s" /> Then he began to smooth the log. <break time="0.8s" /> And the voice laughed. <break time="0.8s" /> Stop, you are tickling me. <break time="0.8s" /> The poor old man fell down. <break time="0.8s" /> In fright. <break time="0.8s" /> And his red nose turned blue.
